title: DAY 34/90
PIPE LOSSES
scenes.voice: Day thirty four of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge, seventy two days to go. Today the flow turns chaotic: turbulent flow and head losses in pipes.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Subject, fluid mechanics. Topic, turbulent flow and pipe losses. Head loss numericals are a GATE favourite, so practise them well.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover elementary turbulent flow, the Darcy Weisbach equation and Moody chart, losses in bends and fittings, and pipes in series and parallel.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. At fixed flow, halving diameter raises friction loss thirty two times, since loss varies as one over D to the fifth. Exit loss is one full velocity head.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: Grab the practice PDF on Telegram now. Tonight's test runs seven to nine P. M.: open it from the link in our Telegram channel, or simply visit our website, on mobile or laptop.
